name: PianoFlow: Piano & MIDI
subtitle: Play, practice & record
promotionalText: Your Mac becomes an 88-key piano. Follow sheet music, import your own MIDI songs, connect a MIDI keyboard, and keep every take.
description:
Play, practice, and record on an 88-key piano, right on your Mac.

PianoFlow brings a full keyboard, guided practice, scrolling sheet music, MIDI input, and a recording studio to macOS. Resize the window to give yourself as much keyboard as you want.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Move from A0 to C8 using octave shortcuts and a range slider. Adjust key width, note labels, and volume. Add sustain, see the chords you play, and keep time with the metronome. Connect a MIDI keyboard to play chords and glissandos with velocity.

PRACTICE AT YOUR PACE
Explore scales, arpeggios, chords, and familiar melodies with highlighted keys and scrolling sheet music. Practice your left hand, right hand, or both. Rhythm coach adds a count-in and note timing feedback. Set a tempo goal and track daily progress on your Mac.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Import a Standard MIDI file, choose its tracks, and assign parts to each hand. Connect a compatible USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for velocity-sensitive playing and sustain-pedal input.

SAVE WHAT YOU PLAY
Record notes, velocity, and sustain. Rename and replay takes, share MIDI, and export full-take Concert Grand M4A audio at normal speed for free. Your recordings and imported songs stay in your local library.

OPTIONAL PIANOFLOW PREMIUM
One purchase unlocks Warm Studio and Bright Hall sound profiles, playback speed controls, loops, selected sections, saving trimmed copies, and lossless WAV export. Concert Grand, guided practice, basic recording and replay, MIDI sharing, and full-take Concert M4A export remain free. No subscription is required.

PianoFlow for Mac shows no ads.

ONE PURCHASE, EVERY DEVICE
PianoFlow Premium is a universal purchase. Buy it once and it unlocks on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad when you use the same Apple Account.

MIDI import supports Standard MIDI formats 0 and 1 with PPQN timing. Imported notation may be simplified; Rhythm coach grades when notes start, not how long they are held. Playing chords from the keyboard needs connected MIDI hardware; a pointer plays one note at a time. External MIDI hardware and compatible adapters are sold separately.
whatsNew:
PianoFlow comes to the Mac.

• The full 88-key instrument, guided practice, sheet music, and MIDI song import in a resizable Mac window.
• Connect a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for velocity and sustain-pedal input.
• Record, replay, and share MIDI; full-take Concert Grand M4A export is included free.
• PianoFlow Premium is a universal purchase, so an upgrade bought on iPhone or iPad unlocks here too.
• No ads on the Mac.
